entities.summary: Fatai Ayinla-Adekunle was an amateur boxer from Nigeria, who won the gold medal in the men's heavyweight division at the 1973 All-Africa Games in Lagos, Nigeria. He was born in Ibadan, Oyo. Ayinla represented his native country twice at the Summer Olympics: in 1968 and 1972. He claimed a bronze medal at the first World Amateur Boxing Championships in Havana, Cuba (1974).
